title: Jaipur City Palace & Hawa Mahal Touts
description: Aggressive touts claiming monument is closed or offering fake gemstone emporium tours with kickbacks.

title: Amer Fort Elephant & Jeep Ring
description: Unauthorized guides intercepting tourists before ticket booths claiming mandatory guide permits.

title: Baga Beach Water Sports Overcharge Zone
description: Operators quoting ₹3,000 for 2-minute jet ski rides without safety vests or standard union rates.

title: Thivim & Madgaon Railway Taxi Syndicate
description: Taxi drivers refusing prepaid counters and charging 2.5x standard fare to beach destinations.

title: Solang Valley Snow Gear Rental Touts
description: Roadside stalls forcing tourists to rent oversized dirty snow suits at ₹800/person claiming entry bans.

title: Old Manali Auto Stand Price Gouging
description: Night-time auto rickshaws quoting ₹300 for a 1.2 km ride to Mall Road after 8 PM.

title: Dashashwamedh Ghat Aarti Boat Hustle
description: Boatmen charging ₹2,500 for a shared aarti view or demanding sudden religious donations mid-river.

title: Manikarnika Ghat 'Cremation Wood Donation' Scam
description: Fake hospice workers cornering foreigners to donate ₹5,000 for sandalwood for poor families.

title: Taj Mahal West Gate Marble Emporium Detour
description: Rickshaws refusing to go directly to gate, diverting to high-commission alabaster souvenir factories.

title: Agra Fort Fake Audio Guide & Ticket Sellers
description: Unauthorized persons selling invalid photocopied entry passes or broken audio gadgets at inflated rates.
